1.d4 f5 2.Qd3 d6 3.g4.strategy: Attacks f5 twice while only the c8-bishop defends it, so Black has to react immediately. It is a gambit lunge: if Black takes, the queen eyes the open diagonal to h7, but White's kingside is loosened and a pawn has been given.
1.d4 f5 2.Qd3 d6 3.g4.name: Dutch Defence: Manhattan Gambit, Anti-Modern
